lore_anchors.definition: A living human being used as a consumable cultivation vessel; their vital energy is forcibly extracted for another's gain. It is the ultimate commodification of a person in the Mortal Stream.
A high-grade disguise technique that alters body shape and skin color, so effective even early Nascent Soul cultivators may not see through it.
An underground, invitation-only trading hub for high-end or black-market cultivation resources, often run by powerful factions as a front for intelligence gathering.
A major neutral hub in the cultivation world, connected by teleportation formations to distant regions like the outer star seas.
A perilous region of the outer star seas, a boundary zone so dangerous that even high-level cultivators risk death by venturing near its edge.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a "Furnace" in the Mortal Stream?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a living human, usually a female cultivator, whose vital energy is forcibly extracted for another’s cultivation until they die or are crippled—a complete commodification of a person.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li give up the concubine offer?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is in a critical cultivation phase and sees a Foundation Establishment companion as a liability. He also suspects the offer was made out of desperation, not loyalty.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the "abyss" Wen Siyue warns about?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a terrifying boundary zone of the outer star seas where even Nascent Soul cultivators risk death. Its edge is where the Gale Beast's nest is now located.
